summary: Frontend-only (Electron preview via vite preview on the public preview URL). Verified the alignment fix with getBoundingClientRect measurements on #logements, #recherche, #offres, plus non-regression of the keep -> stay-bar -> shareable summary -> compare flow, narrow (820x900) collapsed nav, dark theme, and #combinaisons / home pages. All alignment requirements PASS. One real defect found: source badge text is invisible in dark theme.

ui_bugs.issue: Dark theme: badge keeps hardcoded background rgba(255,255,255,0.94) while color: var(--text) becomes light (rgb(233,238,242)) => contrast ratio 1.17:1. 'Airbnb' / 'Centrale de station' / 'Booking' render as blank white pills (measured on all 3 cards). Sibling badge --ski stays readable, so only this rule needs a fixed dark text color (or a themed background).

issues: Secondary actions 'Suivre'/'Comparer' and 'Ouvrir sur X' use grey rgb(99,113,125) on white (~4.1:1) - acceptable but at the AA limit for 12-13px text

action_items: Fix dark-theme contrast of .lodgcard__badge--src (styles.css ~line 4381): set an explicit dark foreground (e.g. color: #12181f) or theme the background so the source name stays readable in dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: styles.css:4381 mixes a hardcoded light background with a theme token foreground (var(--text)) - the only occurrence of this anti-pattern found by grep; other white-bg pills use fixed dark text.

Screen selection reads location.hash only at mount: a same-document goto (hash-only change) does not switch screens. Not a user-facing bug in Electron but worth a hashchange listener for the web preview and for deep links.
seed_data_creation: None - preview shim injects 3 fake lodgings (Chalet Grand Bec / Résidence Le Névé / Studio Bellevue) on Val Thorens

logements_light..lodgcard__name / __sub: 1 line each, white-space:nowrap + text-overflow:ellipsis, no element clipped mid-word

stations.per-row heights: identical within every one of the 20 rows (e.g. 440.1/440.1, 401.5/401.5, 421.5/421.5)
stations.domcard-save: border 0px none / bg transparent when off; after click aria-pressed=true, class domcard__save--on, bg rgb(244,247,249), border rgb(42,53,63)

offres.offerrow__score: scrollWidth == clientWidth (100px) on all rows, '76 · Très bon' fully visible, not clipped

passed_tests: Logements: 3 cards identical height, all internal rows and the main CTA share the same top; context/title lines truncated with ellipsis on a single line
Stations: same-row card heights equal, 'Voir les logements' tops equal per row, 'Retenir' discreet then accented with aria-pressed=true
Meilleures offres: all 60 rows 117px, names left-aligned at 497px, amounts right-aligned at 934px, score pill not truncated
Keep flow: click lodgcard-keep-9002 -> aria-pressed=true, stay-bar shows 'Chalet Grand Bec' and total '2 839 €'

Shareable summary: stay-bar-share opens stay-summary; textarea contains Val Thorens, dates (dim. 07 févr. → dim. 14 févr., 7 nuits), lodging, 'Coûts :' block and 'Total : 2 839 €'; copy/mail buttons present; close removes the modal
stay-bar-compare navigates to 'Meilleures offres' with steps 1 and 2 marked aria-current='done'
Narrow 820x900: nav-journey-select appears, selecting 'decision' switches to the Décision screen
Dark theme on Logements: alignments preserved, only the source badges regress
#combinaisons (body 7444 chars, price columns aligned) and home page (body 1229 chars) render, zero page errors
context_for_next_testing_agent: No backend (backend supervisor FATAL is expected). Preview URL: https://ski-stay-selector.preview.emergentagent.com. Screens are selected from location.hash READ ONCE at mount => always do a full page.goto with wait_until='domcontentloaded' (a hash-only goto is a same-document nav and does NOT change the screen - it silently reuses the previous screen, which can produce false 'passes'). Wait ~6s after load; never networkidle. stay-summary-text is a TEXTAREA: use input_value()/e.value, inner_text() returns ''. Empty MapLibre canvas is expected in browser preview. Contrast heuristics over translucent pill backgrounds (score pills rgba(...,0.14)) give false positives - verify visually.
rca_of_the_issue: Alignment bug is fixed: .resultgrid stretch + height:100% equalises card heights and margin-top:auto pins the footers, verified numerically (identical heights and identical CTA tops on Logements, per-row equality on Stations, fixed grid columns on Meilleures offres). Remaining defect: .lodgcard__badge--src (styles.css:4381) pairs an opaque light background with color: var(--text); in dark theme --text flips to a near-white value, so the badge label disappears (1.17:1).
